lines.text: The root is Mit! Permit, admit, submit.
Did you know? Mit is Latin for send.
Quick quiz! Which means under plus send?

words.ex: Smoking is not permitted inside the building.
He admitted that he had made a mistake.
Please submit your essay by Friday.

publish.title: Mit root: permit, admit and submit
publish.value: Mit comes from Latin "mittere" (to send). Words: permit, admit and submit. permit = per + mit; admit = ad + mit; submit = sub + mit.
